name: Barbell Hang Snatch
steps: Hold a barbell with a wide overhand snatch grip at your hips, then hinge back with slight knee bend until the bar hangs above your knees.
Drive your hips and legs explosively upward to launch the bar straight up close to your torso.
Drop swiftly beneath the bar into a full overhead squat while punching both arms locked straight overhead.
Stand smoothly from the bottom of the squat with the bar steady overhead, then lower it back to your hips.
tips: Keep your shoulders slightly ahead of the bar in the hang so the bar tracks vertically during extension.
Stabilize the bar firmly over your midfoot before rising out of the full squat.
